title: Download
description: A file of the server to download (a .joim or a .joia), cached by its hash.

url.description: Where to download it: GET with the same credentials; 304 to If-None-Match with the hash.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file (hex), also its ETag.

current.description: Whether it holds what is set up now; false when it changed since (it is written again when the user exits its dialog).
